scope: Static inspection of stock Android 1.0.7 / 230 only; no device, network or real task write

create.content_policy: Nonempty trimmed single line, at most 48 UTF-16 code units; no ISO controls or Unicode line separators. Product suggestion-card policy, not a discovered server maximum.
create.client_id_policy: Java UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes(UTF-8('io-agent-native-todo/1:' + proposal_id)); stable UUID v3 per proposal; retries must retain original content and proposal_id

response.success_condition: Root code equals numeric zero; data is the decoded BaseIdDTO object
response.id_type: Stock helper accepts nonempty strings without requiring numeric-only format and converts numeric input to text. This boundary preserves opaque strings and exact positive JSON long IDs; it rejects other representations.
response.boundary_receipt: The original stock id as a String; HTTP/API success is cloud creation evidence only, not proof of native UI or lens visibility

java_entry.semantics: Copies map, adds __method, emits through original Flutter push EventSink on main thread or posts to its Handler. A null sink drops the event; do not report refresh delivered.

minimal_local_event.note: Use fixed internal refresh event after confirmed creation; this is a local original-plugin notification, not a fabricated CPushMessage or external push request

dart_parser.accepted_shape: root content or data.msg.content; content JSON string or map; type String and body map or JSON string required

task_listener.note: Original listener refreshes the original task provider/cache and has native task-change/glasses synchronization machinery. Runtime provider activation, original-list readback and lens synchronization still need verification; never substitute invented business22 task IDs.

alternative_not_implemented.body: taskList array with operation and clientId
alternative_not_implemented.observation: Original manual RayNeo creation participates in local pending-change/batchSync flow. This boundary intentionally does not synthesize Isar tasks, temporary local IDs or mappings.

remaining_runtime_checks: Confirm create v2 accepts the three-field RayNeo request and returns an original cloud task id for the current account
Confirm the original Flutter push EventSink and AiTaskService provider are active before requesting refresh
Confirm refresh reads the created id into the original task list/cache and the original glasses todo list
On create failure do not ACK suggestion acceptance; a refresh failure after successful create must not cause another blind create
